gherkin.scenario: Submit a new absence request with Sick Leave
given: I am logged in as an employee
when: I click the New Absence button
I select "Sick Leave" as the leave type
I fill in the From date field with "2025-12-01"
I select "Morning" in the From field
I fill in the To date field with "2025-12-01"
I select "Afternoon" in the To field
I fill in the comment field with "test"
then: The message "New leave request was added" should appear on the screen

gherkin_acceptance_criteria: The message "New leave request was added" should be visible on the page
